summary: Tested NEW Quick Mode + Suggest + Admin Cockpit features end-to-end plus regression smoke on OCR & reminders. Backend: 9/9 pytest PASS (test_quickmode_cockpit.py) — POST /transactions with category='' defaults to 'Belum Dikategorikan' + status=pending; full-mode create still works; GET /categories/suggest returns 'Transportasi' for text='beli bensin motor' type=expense on toko.maju history, null for <2 chars, null for gibberish, 403 for cross-tenant; POST /transactions/{id}/review with {status:approved,category:Transportasi} updates BOTH fields AND writes audit_log action=category_changed; review without category preserves original. Prior 5/5 OCR+reminder tests still pass. Frontend: All UI flows PASS — (a) MSME toko.maju: TransactionDialog opens in Quick Mode by default, toggle-mode-button flips category-select/payment-select visibility both ways correctly; (b) typing 'beli bensin motor' in description-input surfaces suggestion-chip 'Saran kategori: Transportasi' within ~500ms, tap applies it and shows applied-category='Transportasi'; submit closes dialog and pending count increments; (c) Admin: nav-cockpit visible in sidebar, goto-cockpit banner button navigates to /admin/kategorisasi; (d) Cockpit page shows cockpit-inbox (13 rows) + cockpit-detail, cockpit-suggestion 'Saran: Pemasaran' surfaces from history match, category chips render with 1-9 kbd hints; (e) keyboard shortcuts: '1' picks first chip (Penjualan/Stok-Bahan etc, emerald highlight), ArrowDown moves active row 0→1, ArrowUp restores, Enter approves with picked category and row is removed from inbox optimistically (13→12→11); cockpit-approve button also works; toast 'Disetujui sebagai Penjualan' shown.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~890 lines — still past 700-line guideline; suggest+reminder+receipts should be extracted into routers (previously flagged, unresolved).

suggest_category returns 200 with suggestion=null for <2 char text — clean UX, but the endpoint reads up to 500 transactions per call unfiltered by date; consider narrower window or text index for scale.

In TransactionDialog submit payload, `category: form.category || (quickMode ? '' : form.category)` — the second branch reduces to form.category so it's just `form.category || ''` in effect; harmless but confusing.

AdminCockpit optimistic remove uses `setActiveIdx((i) => Math.min(i, (rows?.length || 1) - 2))` referencing stale `rows` (closure); works because we also call setRows in same tick, but a functional setState using next length would be cleaner.
AdminCockpit keyboard handler skips only INPUT/TEXTAREA — SELECT inside a custom shadcn dropdown could still swallow keys; edge-case only.

Prior iteration_1 finding remains OPEN and untested this iteration: verify GET /api/transactions?business_id=<other> as MSME returns 403 (my regression test showed msme2 querying bid1 either 403s OR filters — I asserted no leak but did not lock the status code).
seed_data_creation: Created ~5 TEST_-prefixed transactions on toko.maju (TEST_qm, TEST_full, TEST_rev, TEST_rev2) via API; approved several pending transactions via cockpit UI (Kedai Nusantara 'Bayar listrik' → Penjualan/similar, plus 2 more via Enter). Non-destructive residual data, safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quick Mode + Suggest + Cockpit are all fully working. Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_quickmode_cockpit.py + test_new_features.py + backend_test.py. Set env before pytest: `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs)` — REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is required. Note that admin approvals via the cockpit UI have already consumed some pending transactions from Kedai Nusantara; if fresh seed is desired, re-run SEED_DEMO.
